notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.98.24
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - 0.98.24
Jan 3, 2023

Gameplay
-All character's hats grow by 5% - 20% when thrown
-Gus' bodyfire kills more consistently

Balance
-Birthday's pickup range was lowered by 3%
-Birthday's hat recall x-power was lowered by 20%
-Forest's throw speed lowered by 5%
-Forest's dangerous hat drag increased by 5%
-Forest's hat recall x-power lowered by 10%

Levels
-Super Hat Con 1 tweak
-Void 1 tweak

Bugs
-Fatcat's hat collider matches sprite better
-Kiara's collider matches sprite better
-Forest's collider matches sprite better
-Washing Machine Jr's collider matches sprite better

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.98.23
notes.notes:
**Patch Notes - 0.98.23**
November 29, 2022

Friend Pass
* Can play versus other players with Friend Pass now!

Gameplay
* You can now curve your hat while you're stunned. Something to do while you're getting beaten up!
* Footstools while hats are attaching will now kill, instead of footstool

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.98.22 - Kidcat balance
notes.notes:
**Patch Notes 0.98.22**
November 5, 2022 

**Kidcat balance**
* Adjusted her hat physics
* Added the ability to jack hammer by holding down
* Added a super bounce when pressing A while jack hammering
* Adjusted her jump heights

* Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes Nov 1 - 0.98.21
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your feedback on discord!

This patch has some bugfixes and qol improvements addressing your feedback! We also have some larger projects we're starting in response to your requests, stay tuned!

* Add warning if connecting to someone playing on old discord store
* Fix some issues with unlocking skins like bario, bink and cactjessica
* Localization fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes v98.19 - Hot Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v98.19

Bugs
* Fixed issue with unlocking characters at the end of Arcade
* Fixed issue where you had to reselect Solo Modes to re-play Arcade Mode
* Minor translation fixes

Quality of Life
* Added a skip button to the credits at the end of Arcade Mode

Level Tweaks
* Tweak to Void 1 level
* Tweak to Factory 4 level

notes.title: Patch Notes - Oct 24
notes.notes:
Wow thanks for all the streams over the weekend!

We noticed that some people looking for online matches didn't know about the friendpass option where your friends can play free, so we added a link for it to the online modal!

Also some bugfixes and qol improvements in this one. More to come!
